title: Impatiently
summary: IMPA'TIENTLY, adverb With uneasiness or restlessness; as, to bear disappointment impatiently 1. With eager desire causing uneasiness; as, to wait impatiently for the arrival of one's friend. 2. Passio

inlines.v: IMPA'TIENTLY, adverb With uneasiness or restlessness; as, to bear disappointment impatiently 1. With eager desire causing uneasiness; as, to wait impatiently for the arrival of one's friend. 2. Passionately; ardently.
